evidence.title: Claude Cowork + Project. - by Ruben Hassid - How to AI

name: Claude Cowork + Project
summary: Guide to setting up Claude Cowork Projects with persistent memory, instructions and scheduled tasks.
description: A how-to post by Ruben Hassid on Claude Cowork Projects: what they are, how to create one from scratch, by importing an existing Claude Project or from a local folder, how to run daily workflows like a weekly newsletter, and where the feature falls short.
